fields.label: Trigger Name
fields.description: Short name shown in the Triggers list, e.g. 'Flag big discounts'.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: When off, the trigger never fires (it stays out of the dispatch map).

fields.label: DocType
fields.description: The DocType whose events fire this trigger.

fields.label: Doc Event
fields.options:
validate
before_submit
after_insert
on_update
on_submit
on_cancel
on_trash
on_update_after_submit
fields.description: Frappe document event. validate/before_submit run INSIDE the save and can block it (Script actions only).

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional one-line summary of what this trigger does.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Optional. Same semantics as Frappe Webhook conditions, e.g. doc.status == "Open". Evaluated with {"doc": doc, "utils": <safe utils>} exactly like webhook.get_context; the trigger fires only when it is truthy.

fields.label: Action Type
fields.description: Script = deterministic sandboxed Python (runs inside the transaction, can block saves). LLM = background LLM evaluation after commit (never blocks). Intake = turns documents dropped in a folder, or attached to a record, into draft records.

fields.label: Script
fields.description: Sandboxed (RestrictedPython) script; same execution context as a DocType Event Server Script ('doc' is available). frappe.throw() blocks the save.

fields.label: Managed Server Script
fields.description: Managed by the trigger controller: the materialized (always-disabled) Server Script the engine dispatches. Never edit directly.

fields.label: LLM Instruction
fields.description: What the LLM should check on each fired event; the document snapshot is appended as fenced untrusted data.

fields.label: LLM Daily Cap
fields.description: Max LLM evaluations per day for this trigger. 0 or empty = default 100; hard ceiling 2000.

fields.label: Allow read-only lookups
fields.description: Lets the LLM read related records (up to 3 lookups, 20 rows each) before it answers. Lookups read as the trigger owner (a trigger owned by Administrator reads as Administrator), so they can see whatever the owner can. Findings of such triggers are visible only to the owner and to managers. Contact, Address and framework tables (users, roles, queues, logs, files) cannot be looked up. Reads only.

fields.label: Intake source
fields.description: Where the documents come from: a Files folder, or files attached to a record.

fields.label: Folder
fields.description: Files folder path to watch, e.g. Home/Production Sheets.

fields.label: Record DocType
fields.description: DocType whose attachments are read.

fields.label: Create drafts in
fields.description: DocType the draft records are created in.

fields.label: Fields to read
fields.description: Fields, optional table, match fields and defaults.

fields.label: Reading instructions
fields.description: Extra guidance for reading the document (max 4000 characters).

fields.label: Allow incomplete drafts
fields.description: Create the draft even when a mandatory field could not be read. Missing fields are listed on the draft. Submit still needs every mandatory field.

fields.label: Status field on record
fields.description: Optional field on the record that receives the intake status.

fields.label: Draft link field on record
fields.description: Optional field on the record that receives a link to the draft.

fields.label: Source Conversation
fields.description: Provenance: the Jarvis conversation id when this trigger was created via chat.
